_note: Name-facts for New Zealand (FT-72, docs/PLAN_V0.12.md). See italy.json for the rules.
Begun with the towns on the continent maps, each as a "city" entry so that a region
of the same id, written later, never shows a town's sentences.

en: Named for the Duke of Wellington.
The southernmost capital of a sovereign state.
Known as Windy Wellington, for the gales through Cook Strait.
it: Prende il nome dal duca di Wellington.
La capitale di Stato sovrano più a sud del mondo.
Chiamata Windy Wellington, per le raffiche che attraversano lo stretto di Cook.
